name: TimeAverager
description: Average data over time for specific sphere identified by ids. Data are position, velocity, angular velocity, global resultant force and torque, resultant force and torque computed from contacts only and contact force field (see description below). The data must be first initialized with its...

attributes.name: computeContactForceField
attributes.description: Wether to compute and average contact force field at the surface of the particles (experimental feature). The contact force field is obtained by ditributing the contact forces on a grid at the surface of the sphere. The contact forces are spread on each point of the grid, according to the distance between the contact point and the grid point. The algorythm uses a gaussian kernel to smooth the field. If computeContactForceField is true, grid and sigma parameters must be filled in. This can significantly increase the computation time for dense grid or high number of particles.

attributes.name: grid
attributes.description: Grid on which to compute the contact force field. Should be a list of 3D coordinates at the surface of the particle (a simple way to generate a well distributed grid at the surface of a sphere is with the Fibonacci lattice method).

attributes.name: sigma
attributes.description: Standard deviation of the Gaussian function, which determines how the contact forces are weighted based on their distance from a contact point. It is usually set at the order of the distance between two points in the grid.

attributes.name: ids
attributes.description: Ids list of bodies affected by this PartialEngine.

attributes.name: dead
attributes.description: If true, this engine will not run at all; can be used for making an engine temporarily deactivated and only resurrect it at a later point.

attributes.name: ompThreads
attributes.description: Number of threads to be used in the engine. If ompThreads<0 (default), the number will be typically OMP_NUM_THREADS or the number N defined by 'yade -jN' (this behavior can depend on the engine though). This attribute will only affect engines whose code includes openMP parallel regions (e.g. InteractionLoop). This attribute is mostly useful for experiments or when combining ParallelEngine with engines that run parallel regions, resulting in nested OMP loops with different number of threads at each level.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: execTime
attributes.description: Cumulative time in nanoseconds this Engine took to run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: execCount
attributes.description: Cumulative count this engine was run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Engine itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled == True.

methods.name: initialization
methods.description: Initialize tAccu to zero and the averaged variables to there instantaneous values. Necessary to execute before any simulation run, otherwise it crashes.

methods.description: Get averaged position of particle since last initialization

methods.name: getTorque
